title: config/commits.json
description: The rules of a commit message, read by scripts/kit/check-commits.mjs: the subject is type(scope): Subject (#id), then a blank line and a body.

types.description: The allowed types of the subject.

subjectMax.description: The most characters of the Subject, the part between the colon and the (#id).

bodyMax.description: The most characters of a line of the body; a single word longer than this, such as a URL, is allowed.
